gen-dafont-bloody-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic keeps its x-height high and its curves generously open, a modern face that stays out of the way. And Bloody's big round bowls give the pair its loudest, most commanding streak.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC feels approachable, with every curve ending in a clear opening and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Bloody's heavy, round-bowled display letters shout above it, while Carrois Gothic SC just hums along underneath.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up close to the caps and lets daylight through every curve, so it reads friendly and crisp. Bloody growls above it.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-chocolate-classical: Modern and sizable, Chocolate Classical Sans sits low on the line. Bloody's commanding round bowls are the loud half, and the broad-nibbed pen stroke below never curls shut, which keeps the pair from tipping into chaos.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-comme: Contemporary through and through, Comme runs smooth, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. And Bloody's big round bowls give the pair its strongest quality: a loud, commanding entrance.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-cossette-texte: Bloody comes in with big, round, heavy bowls. Cossette Texte follows in a monoline stroke from start to finish, with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height that make a long stretch of text go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-duru-sans: Clean and modern, Duru Sans spreads wide openings across small letters, and its bodies dominate the line while ascenders hardly show. Bloody just growls above it.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-fresca: Fresca reads without any calligraphic thinning, its apertures keeping every counter connected to the outside and its ascenders short above big bowls. Bloody shouts; Fresca simply speaks.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-funnel-sans: Clean and crisp, Funnel Sans keeps ascenders tight to the x-height line and opens its lowercase e like a pried clasp. Funnel Sans is the quiet one here, while Bloody earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-gafata: Gafata reads as a tall band of letters with short stalks above. Bloody's round-bowled display swagger sits over it, while Gafata's wide-eyed lowercase e shapes keep a long passage moving at a comfortable, professional pace.
